notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Some bugs were fixed and new features added.

Boss Fight - boss not responding fixed

Added Music Control
Added configuration for left handed people
Added checkpoints in the Story mode. 

To adress early issues in the game, where it was almost unplayable, we want to give our sincere apologies. By mistake we updated with a wrong build which caused so many bugs, issues and so on. Now it all should be fixed.

Thank you everyone for the feedbacks
